reasoning: No Hantavirus vaccine has entered Phase 3 trials; the most advanced candidates are in early clinical phases. FDA full approval requires completion of pivotal efficacy trials and a lengthy review, which is not possible in the 2-year window given the current pipeline. The market's 8.5% is an order of magnitude too optimistic.
evidence_points: ClinicalTrials.gov and PubMed show no Phase 3 Hantavirus vaccine trials; the most recent U.S. Army DNA vaccine trial was Phase 1 (Sin Nombre, 2020).
Vaccine development from Phase 1 to FDA approval typically takes 5–10 years, even with accelerated pathways; a Phase 2/3 start in 2024/2025 would not complete by 2026.
Hantavirus is an orphan disease with sporadic cases (~20 per year in the U.S.), providing little commercial or epidemic urgency to drive rapid approval.
sources_consulted: Historical vaccine approval timelines (e.g., Ebola, COVID-19)
